title: My Spreadsheet Era Was My Origin Story
excerpt: Before React, there was a very tired accountant and one very long worksheet.
body:
As an assistant accountant I reconciled records from several branches by hand. Same columns, same mistakes, every week.

So I wrote a script that pulled everything into one synchronised worksheet. It wasn't pretty. It saved hours.

That was the moment I realised I liked building the tool more than doing the task. Everything since has been that feeling, scaled up.
